lines.beaver: 선배님, 지난번 실수는 제 부주의 때문이었어요.
lines.beaver_en: Sunbae, last time's mistake was due to my carelessness.
lines.beaver_roman: seonbaenim, jinanbeon silsuneun je bujuui ttaemunieosseoyo.
lines.en: It's good to see you reflecting on it seriously.

lines.beaver_en: I'll take responsibility for this job to the end.
lines.en: Great, your resolve to take responsibility is impressive.

lines.beaver_en: I'll practice my presentation two hours every day.
lines.learner: 꾸준하게 연습하다 보면 분명히 좋아질 거야.
lines.en: If you keep practicing steadily, you'll surely improve.
lines.roman: kkujunhage yeonseupada bomyeon bunmyeonghi joajil geoya.

lines.beaver_en: But I have no talent for speaking.
lines.learner: 재능은 타고나는 게 다가 아니야. 의지가 중요해.
lines.en: Talent isn't just what you're born with. Will matters.
lines.roman: jaeneungeun tagonaneun ge daga aniya. uijiga jungyohae.

lines.beaver_en: Then what mindset should I have?
lines.learner: 작은 일에도 소홀하지 말고 정성을 다해 봐.
lines.en: Don't neglect even small things; give them your all.
lines.roman: jageun iredo soholhaji malgo jeongseongeul dahae bwa.

lines.beaver_en: Yes, this time I've really made up my mind.
lines.en: That's a good pledge. I believe in you.

lines.beaver_en: Actually, my motivation had dropped a bit lately.
lines.learner: 하다 보면 의욕도 열정도 다시 생길 거야.
lines.en: If you keep at it, drive and passion will come back.
lines.roman: hada bomyeon uiyokdo yeoljeongdo dasi saenggil geoya.

lines.beaver_en: But what if I get nervous on presentation day?
lines.en: Just speak confidently and with self-assurance.

lines.learner: 네가 우리 팀에 있어서 정말 든든해.
lines.en: I feel really reassured having you on our team.
lines.roman: nega uri time isseoseo jeongmal deundeunhae.

lines.beaver: 이제 해낼 수 있다는 확신이 생겼어요.
lines.beaver_en: Now I'm convinced I can do it.
lines.beaver_roman: ije haenael su itdaneun hwaksini saenggyeosseoyo.
lines.en: That conviction and will are enough. I'm rooting for you!
